pr623.identity_change: request-time IdentityRouter.resolve is read/validate-only and rejects missing, duplicate, noncanonical-terminal or stale-generation permanent sessions
pr623.readiness_change: _runtime_ready now requires exact canonical session-row cardinality before projecting rows by user, so duplicate canonical sessions fail closed before terminal probing

counterhypothesis: A source-level exact-cardinality guard can still be wrong or regress adjacent runtime behavior; no promotion is justified until an authorized isolated execution actually runs the focused and adjacent regressions at exact identity.
anti_duplication: The duplicate-session readiness defect was discovered independently during this go but was already repaired by the existing PR623 lane before a competing patch was written; no second identity/readiness lane was created.
